source_inspection.source_snapshot: Pinned immutable URLs retain exact inspected input; external agent source copies are separately indexed in their reports.

package.license: MIT OR Apache-2.0; component/third-party notices require per-file adoption audit
package.ui: egui 0.36; Handshake WP012 uses 0.33, so do not wholesale import UI
package.dependencies: hayro 0.7.1, hayro-syntax 0.7.2, lopdf 0.45; vendored patches for hayro/lopdf/winit need individual maintenance review
package.build: resolver 3, thin LTO release/codegen-units=1; development optimization/debug choices are candidate data, not approved Handshake changes

findings.observed: Rendering uses hayro; metadata/inspection use lopdf rather than a complete independent native engine.
findings.decision: Compare direct hayro/lopdf reuse with adapted PdfCraft leaves; no claim everything is original Rust implementation by this repository.

findings.observed: Bounds-checked lexer and parser recursion ceiling MAX_DEPTH=128 exist.
findings.decision: Useful parser pattern; malformed-object/filter/expansion/resource boundary corpus still required.

findings.observed: Incremental writer normally retains prior bytes, but writer.rs L175-179 redirects full_save_required/encryption changes/reconstructed documents to write_full.
findings.decision: Preserve existing full-save safeguard; choose operation-aware output policy and require independent residue proof. Redaction is not necessarily incremental.

findings.observed: ApplyRedactions invokes redact::apply; redact/lib.rs L421 sets doc.require_full_save(); generic save_bytes L2488 calls write_incremental, whose L175-179 honors the flag and performs full rewrite. save_full_bytes L2499 is also available and refuses signed files.
findings.decision: Reuse and preserve the inspected redaction-to-full-rewrite safeguard. No residual-original bug demonstrated. Independently verify all privacy operations and exported history/attachments; partial call-chain review was insufficient.

findings.observed: Redaction removes target content/resources and checks remaining region content; related metadata/tag cleanup exists.
findings.decision: Reuse only after independent byte, object-tree, extraction, OCR/image and reopened-render residue checks, including recovery/source attachments.

findings.observed: Preflight implements declared A2b/A3b checks and conversion helpers, not a demonstrated complete PDF/A, PDF/X or PDF/UA conformity oracle.
findings.decision: Adopt rules as findings with explicit scope; use independent format validators and press/accessibility workflow proofs.
Carry manual/skipped findings through output receipts; never mark PDF/UA complete from the rule count.

findings.observed: Typed engine automation is independent of UI and can return JSON/PNG with document IDs and optional path confinement.
findings.decision: Adapt engine APIs under Handshake ToolGate/Argus/resource grant registry; do not introduce a parallel shipped daemon/MCP authority.

findings.observed: mark_saved reopens saved bytes as editor authority and updates saved generation; editor transaction clones support recovery.
findings.decision: Useful save/rebase pattern; interrupted write, reopen failure, dirty generation and undo semantics need actual production-boundary proof.

findings.observed: Author records lack of systematic side-by-side Acrobat fidelity checks and unfinished native renderer/conformity work.
findings.decision: Early candidate code, not full Acrobat parity or verified production readiness.

selected_for_detailed_prototype_review: render adapter and engine transaction patterns
rejected_for_wholesale_fork: compliance claims based on partial checks
Any adapter bypassing existing full-save-required safeguards or treating source review as residue proof
adoption.not_forked: No upstream repository fork or code vendoring performed this session; pinned source audits precede adoption.

independent_proof.state: NOT_RUN; planning session and NON_EXECUTION stub
required: Differential render against Adobe Acrobat using varied text/CJK/RTL, transparencies, font subsets, spot/overprint and malformed files.
Sanitize/redact a document, full-rewrite export, extract and search decompressed streams/original revisions/recovery attachments, reopen independently and confirm content absence.
PDF/A/PDF/X/PDF/UA checks through independent validators plus declared manual accessibility review.
Signed/encrypted save refusal and exact grant confinement without data leaks.
counterfactuals: A visually blank redacted page may still contain removed bytes in prior incremental revisions.
A green preflight report may miss a rule outside the implementation's declared profile.
PNG/JSON output is not model integration until ToolGate, grants, Argus revision receipts and diagnostic consumers actually execute.

design_review.finding: Initial engine-only audit omitted downstream full_save_required safeguard; exact full source chain inspected and audit corrected before delivery.
independent_source_checks: UI specialist redact flag and COS writer inspection; root independently reopened exact lines
